helpScarto: scarto <i0> <i1>     Discard the 2 surplus cards (dealer only)
hintReasonFollowLow: You cannot take it, so follow with a low card
hintReasonFollowTrump: Follow with a trump to take the trick
hintReasonLeadLow: Lead a low card and hold your strength back
hintReasonLeadTrump: Lead a trump to seize the initiative
hintReasonPlayMatto: Play the Matto (it takes no trick but is exempt from following)
hintReasonPlayPapa: Play a papa (four of equal rank -- the later one played wins)
papiNote: The four papi rank equal -- if more than one lands in a trick, the later-played wins
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... Play a card (must follow the led suit; must trump when void. The Matto is always legal)
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... Score and move to the next round
promptScarto: The dealer must discard {{count}} cards (trumps and the Matto cannot be discarded)
promptScartoHelp: scarto <i0> <i1> ... Give the positions of the cards to discard
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... Continue to the next trick
